title: Parameters A, B, C, D and Graph of y = (1/2)*sin(pi*x - pi) + 1/2
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the general sine function f(x) = A\sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{B}(x - C)\right) + D, identify the constants A, B, C, and D for y = \frac{1}{2}\sin(\pi x - \pi) + \frac{1}{2} and describe its graph.

steps.title: Factor the Argument to Match Standard Sinusoid Form
steps.explanation: Factor pi out of pi*x - pi to get pi*(x - 1), and write pi as 2*pi/2.
steps.why: Factoring out the coefficient of x isolates the true horizontal shift C.

steps.title: Identify the Constants A, B, C, and D
steps.explanation: Comparing with A*sin((2*pi/B)*(x - C)) + D gives A = 1/2, period B = 2, horizontal shift C = 1, and vertical shift D = 1/2.

steps.title: Describe the Graph and Key Landmarks
steps.explanation: The sinusoid oscillates between y = 0 and y = 1 about the midline y = 1/2, starting a cycle at (1, 1/2) with period 2.
